description: Land Acquisition - Buddliyagama, Weeraketiya D/S Division, Hambantota District - Mandaduwa, Weeraketiya D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific lots of land being acquired by the government for a public purpose, including descriptions, locations, extents, and claimants. The content is published in "PART III – LANDS" and deals solely with land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
